basis: Manual common-height roof-corner fit within current playable gym footprint. This separates local landmark spacing from the uncertain global image/elevation projection. Not extracted original dimensions.
findings: The previous air conditioner sat too far from the north transition. The common-height local fit moves its centre from Z=27.5 to Z=23.7 and increases its footprint from 8.5 × 6.2m to 10.5 × 8.5m.
The west hip is offset south of the centreline; original footage at 2:07 shows it beside the westward landing line.
The skylight fit changes X from 49 to 51 while retaining nearly the same Z. The earlier global-projection candidate that moved it 6m north was rejected.
The current gym bounds, roof heights and absolute dimensions remain inferred. This fit establishes consistent relative placement, not extracted original measurements.

source.method: Manual landmarks fitted within the existing roof footprint; vertical projection is inferred. Rounded authored coordinates preserve playable surface joins.

validationNotes: The east kicker clears the enlarged unit with the first landing on roof at approach speed 18; the accepted case cannot land on the unit and roll off.

Additional native-input probes at both z=23.7 and z=26 clear the unit at approach speeds 14, 16 and 18. The seventeenth iteration shortens the kicker; all eight probes now clear at their first landing, including speed 12.

The shortened plank uses the same rounded path for visible support and grind collision. A sharp compound bend ejected the native grind; the 1.3m corner trim completes all 15.775m and lands on the awning.
Roof 2 Roof, skylight drops, all vent/hip crossings and camera clearance are rechecked after the common placement change.

Sixteenth iteration: the close source roof crop and original 2:07 footage place short freestanding rails on the open west roof. Removed the invented AC-kicker rail, which sat up to 0.487m below the riding surface. The two source rails pass grounded approaches, complete grinds and roof rollouts in both directions, with an inferred 0.65m bar height.

Seventeenth iteration: the original supplied image grid resolves a compact east kicker next to the unit. Its inferred run is 2.8m with a 0.75m gap, replacing the earlier 5.8m run / 2.65m gap. The Roof 2 Roof approach now uses clear roof east of the kicker at X=65.5. A continuous native hill/turn/AC/hip/roof route completes in 282 frames without resets, injected motion or bails. The supplied low-resolution pixel landmarks are approximate; original world dimensions remain unverified.

Eighteenth iteration: add the visible curved lower north/west/south sides continuing vertically to the unit top. Radius 1.2m, vertical extension 0.9m and small 0.18m west corners are inferred. One 29.345m top coping follows the three sides. Native air returns, low-speed rollback, forward landings and complete grinds are tested without changing skater movement. The later port supports this topology only.

userScaleIteration.note: Gameplay adjustment after user requested 2–3x enlargement; source dimensions remain inferred.
